title: RegulatoryEntityCrosswalk
description: One row per approved RegulatoryEntityLink: an audited, human-adjudicated mapping from a regulatory observation to an AguaLuz asset. Every field traces back to the human decision that produced it (decided_at/decided_by/decision_rationale) -- this is consumption of an already-approved decision, never a promotion in its own right. Written only by scripts/promote_regulatory_links.py, which only reads decision_state=approved rows (fail-closed at the API layer per server/backend/regulatory_api.py, and schema-guaranteed by regulatory_entity_link.schema.json to already carry decided_at/decided_by/decision_rationale and empty contradictions).
